name: DocuSense
description: Local document store for AI agents. Reads PDF, DOCX, HTML and Markdown files by section and claim with SHA-256 verified citations, version diffs, blame and cross-document contradiction checks. Runs locally on embedded SQLite.
author: hksharma2004

DOCUSENSE_HOME.description: Folder for the local database, blobs and indexes.

DOCUSENSE_ADD_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated folders that add_document may read. Defaults to the home directory.

DOCUSENSE_TOOLS.description: Set to core to expose a smaller tool set.
